-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Railway API token and connectivity.

railway-get-user.name: railway-get-user
railway-get-user.description: Get current Railway user info including available workspaces.

railway-list-workspaces.name: railway-list-workspaces
railway-list-workspaces.description: List all Railway workspaces available to the current user.

railway-list-projects.name: railway-list-projects
railway-list-projects.description: List all Railway projects in the connected account.

railway-get-project.name: railway-get-project
railway-get-project.description: Get detailed information about a Railway project including services and environments.

railway-create-project.name: railway-create-project
railway-create-project.description: Create a new Railway project. Requires a workspaceId - use railway-list-workspaces to get available workspaces.

params.name: Project name
params.workspaceId: Workspace ID to create the project in (use railway-list-workspaces to get IDs)

railway-delete-project.name: railway-delete-project
railway-delete-project.description: Delete a Railway project. This action is irreversible!

params.projectId: The Railway project ID to delete

railway-list-environments.name: railway-list-environments
railway-list-environments.description: List all environments in a Railway project.

railway-create-environment.name: railway-create-environment
railway-create-environment.description: Create a new environment in a Railway project (e.g., staging, production).

railway-list-services.name: railway-list-services
railway-list-services.description: List all services in a Railway project.

railway-create-service.name: railway-create-service
railway-create-service.description: Create a new service in a Railway project.

railway-delete-service.name: railway-delete-service
railway-delete-service.description: Delete a service from a Railway project.

params.serviceId: The Railway service ID to delete

railway-list-variables.name: railway-list-variables
railway-list-variables.description: List environment variables for a service.

railway-set-variables.name: railway-set-variables
railway-set-variables.description: Set environment variables for a service.

params.variables: Key-value pairs of environment variables to set

railway-list-deployments.name: railway-list-deployments
railway-list-deployments.description: List recent deployments for a service.

railway-get-deployment.name: railway-get-deployment
railway-get-deployment.description: Get the status of a specific deployment.

railway-redeploy.name: railway-redeploy
railway-redeploy.description: Trigger a redeploy of an existing deployment.

params.deploymentId: The Railway deployment ID to redeploy

railway-create-domain.name: railway-create-domain
railway-create-domain.description: Create a Railway-generated domain for a service (e.g., myapp.up.railway.app).

railway-connect-repo.name: railway-connect-repo
railway-connect-repo.description: Connect a GitHub repository to a Railway service. Works with both public and private repos (if GitHub is connected in your Railway account). Automatically triggers a deployment.

railway-deploy-public-repo.name: railway-deploy-public-repo
railway-deploy-public-repo.description: Deploy a public GitHub repository to Railway. Creates a new service from the repo. Only works with PUBLIC repositories. For private repos, use railway-connect-repo instead.

railway-create-volume.name: railway-create-volume
railway-create-volume.description: Create a persistent volume for a service (useful for databases).

params.mountPath: Path to mount the volume (e.g., "/data/db" for MongoDB)

railway-get-build-logs.name: railway-get-build-logs
railway-get-build-logs.description: Get build logs for a deployment. Shows what happened during the build/compile phase.

params.deploymentId: The deployment ID to get build logs for
params.limit: Maximum number of log lines to return (default: 100, max: 500)
params.filter: Optional text filter to search within logs

railway-get-deploy-logs.name: railway-get-deploy-logs
railway-get-deploy-logs.description: Get runtime/deployment logs for a deployment. Shows application output, errors, and startup logs.

params.deploymentId: The deployment ID to get runtime logs for
params.limit: Maximum number of log lines to return (default: 100, max: 500)
params.filter: Optional text filter to search within logs

name: Railway
description: Deploy projects to Railway directly from Teros workspaces. Supports automatic deployments, environment management, and database provisioning.

changelog.notes: Initial release — create and deploy projects, manage services, environments, variables, domains and volumes, and watch deployment logs
